messages.subject: Instruction - The Vault Birmingham defects investigation
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Dr Lyle,

We act for Brampton Leisure Limited (part of Kingsford Group) in relation to defects at their flagship health club, The Vault Birmingham. We should be grateful if Lyle Forsyth Associates would investigate and report on three principal issues: (1) water ingress at the pool hall curtain-wall/roof abutment; (2) the performance of the pool water-treatment plant against the Employer's Requirements; and (3) the pool hall ventilation/humidity control.

We enclose the building contract and Employer's Requirements separately. Please treat your instructions and report as prepared for the purpose of contemplated litigation and therefore privileged. Could you indicate a timescale and fee estimate?

Kind regards,

Tom Gallagher
Associate | Whitfield Carter LLP
Confidential and may be legally privileged.

messages.subject: RE: Instruction - The Vault Birmingham defects investigation
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Tom,

Thank you - we'd be glad to assist. We propose four site visits including airflow and humidity measurement and inspection of the water-treatment plant and commissioning records. We can deliver a report by mid-October. Our fee estimate is in the region of £90,000-£100,000 plus VAT depending on the extent of opening-up required.

We'll arrange first access for w/c 23 September.

Best wishes,
Dr Margaret Lyle
Lyle Forsyth Associates
